name: ticker
description: 底部滚动字幕条：新闻式横排信息带
css: #tpl-ticker { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; background: #0a0a1a; } #tpl-ticker .tk-title { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 72px; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; padding: 0 8%; text-align: center; } #tpl-ticker .tk-band { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6d8bff, #8b6dff); padding: 26px 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } #tpl-ticker .tk-items { font-size: 30px; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: 3px; padding-left: 40px; }
